# OrbTran-II

![logo](logo.png)

OrbTran-II is a Fortran program designed to convert pseudo-canonical molecular orbital (PCMO) data files
--- generated by the quadratically convergent state-averaged MCSCF-type (CASSCF, RASSCF, or GASSCF) calculations using
[Molpro](http://www.molpro.net/) or [BDF](https://bdf-manual.readthedocs.io/zh_CN/latest/)
--- into formats compatible with other programs, most notably
[OpenMolcas](https://gitlab.com/Molcas/OpenMolcas).
This conversion facilitates the comparison of results obtained from multi-reference methods such as MRCI, CASPT2, NEVPT2,
and MCPDFT by different quantum chemistry programs.

See the following references for its applications.
1. He, C. Li, and W. Zou. **Theoretical study on the low-lying electronic states of ScO**.
*J. Quant. Spectrosc. Radiat. Transf.*, 345, 109559 (2025).
[DOI: 10.1016/j.jqsrt.2025.109559](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jqsrt.2025.109559)
2. C. Li and W. Zou. **Low-lying electronic states of RhF and IrF: A theoretical study**.
*Chem. Phys. Lett.*, 882, 142454 (2026).
[DOI: 10.1016/j.cplett.2025.142454](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cplett.2025.142454)
3. C. Li and W. Zou. **Electronic states of cobalt monofluoride (CoF) below 5 eV**.
*J. Quant. Spectrosc. Radiat. Transf.*, 357, 109910 (2026).
[DOI: 10.1016/j.jqsrt.2026.109910](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jqsrt.2026.109910)

## Features

* Reads PCMOs.
1. PCMOs may be computed by Molpro's `MULTI` module or BDF's `MCSCF` module.
2. All eight Abelian point groups have been supported.
3. Spherical Gaussian functions with angular momenta ranging from 0 to 6 (_spdfghi_) can be identified.
* Writes PCMOs.
1. RasOrb format used by [BDF](https://bdf-manual.readthedocs.io/zh_CN/latest/),
[OpenMolcas](https://gitlab.com/Molcas/OpenMolcas), or
[Molpro](http://www.molpro.net/).
2. MOLEKEL format used by [Orca](https://www.faccts.de/orca/)
(up to _h_-functions). Symmetry-equivalent atoms are not supported.
3. MOLDEN format (up to _h_-functions). Symmetry-equivalent atoms are not supported.
4. A new RasOrb file with adjusted PCMO coefficients.

For usage instructions, see the manual in PDF format.
